clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, a novice night elf priest receives a call to return home. The novice has wandered as far as Elwynn Forest, where Priestess Josetta relays an urgent message from Darnassus: return to the Temple of the Moon and continue spiritual training under Priestess Alathea.

Night elves are an unusual sight in Elwynn Forest, and a young acolyte among its human settlements draws attention. When you arrive in Goldshire, Priestess Josetta greets you warmly with news. A Sister of Elune has traveled across continents seeking you, bearing an urgent command from the Temple of the Moon. It is time to return to Kalimdor and advance your calling.

At the heart of Darnassus stands the Temple of the Moon, center of night elf faith and leadership. Priestess Alathea and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind oversee the Sisterhood’s instruction, watching their disciples even when curiosity carries them overseas. When you return, the priestesses welcome you with motherly concern and immediately set you to deeper studies of the Moon Goddess’s celestial mysteries.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, yes, hello, friend? I'm glad you stopped to talk for a moment. You are a far way from home at such a young age--I admire such ambition. I wish when I was younger I could have mustered the courage to travel the world.

There was a priestess of your order here looking for you not too long ago. She said it was very urgent you returned to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and speak to Priestess Alathea--it had something to do with your training. I wouldn't dally too long if you can help it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, you've returned home, friend. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
